prefix_method.stop_rule: Traverse the complete ordered action list and stop before the first action whose next query or explicit-open count would exceed either cap. Do not skip that action to admit later ones.
prefix_method.budget_units: Each query event is one scalar individual query. Every open/click/find/reopen/failure is one explicit-open unit, including operation fields nested under event_type=open. Start, stop and local bookkeeping consume neither.
prefix_method.ordering: Both supplied event_index and recorded UTC start order are retained. UTC ties use event_index. R3-B disagreement remains indeterminate at candidate level. R6-B stop is a whole-run interval summary and is not part of the acquisition prefix.
prefix_method.acquisition_rule: Recognize integer acquisition_event, open_event, open_event_index, open_event_indices, direct_read_event, direct_section_event, direct_section_read, direct_open and supporting reads. A query/initial navigation hit alone does not credit the final directly-read candidate. Every declared necessary read must be in the prefix.

R6-B rank3: open_event_indices[3,6] requires the interaction/keyboard section read at6; initial navigation/API window3 alone is insufficient.
